answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, forfeited on duplicate submission, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Work waits on the river until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the meadow of the next round. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. By the copper of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
